realReviews.author: Jordan Smith
realReviews.text: Hired them to take care of a rotten wood paneling on the exterior of  my house.  Someone did a poor job of sealing the window and it created some water damage.  Tam came out, offered me a reasonable price, handled it in a timely manner, and did a quality job.  Highly recommend.

realReviews.author: Jamie Sloan
realReviews.text: If you are looking for a go to resource that is knowledgeable, fair priced, and will return your calls with follow through… look no further. Tam came out, assessed our request, and did an outstanding job with installing a net new dishwasher in the kitchen, a new waterline to the refrigerator, and new soffit vents around the house. We will definitely use Tam for future projects, and highly recommend that you do as well.

realReviews.author: gary donovan
realReviews.text: I needed some bedroom doors put up, called several people all were way to expensive, I called and spoke to Tam and he gave me a really good price, agreed on a time to start the work and actually got there a little earlier than we discussed but only after calling me to see if it was ok to come early.   He took great pride in his work and was very fast and did an awesome job.   I would recommend this young man for any project
